question: What attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment are named together
Such accomplishment belongs to the yoginīs
One possessing it may become dear to them
inference: Attaining enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
